name: Corbera de Llobregat (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the black crow of the Corbera lineage facing the hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 17 March 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4606 of 3 April 2006; it is based on the municipal arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the black crow of the Corbera lineage facing the hoist at the centre.

features.role: crow of the Corbera lineage facing the hoist
